facts.business: A-1 Limited (formerly A-1 Acid Limited) operates in the Acids and Chemicals segment and Sports Equipments segment, with primary revenue from Acids and Chemicals.
key_risks: Concentration risk: One customer contributed Rs. 4,416.73 Lakhs of total revenue from domestic sales in FY 2025-26
Commodity price risk (though stated as not material)
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Details in notes to financial statements and Form AOC-2 (Annexure VI).
